title: DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap): A Controllable and Interactive Red-Teaming Platform for AI Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Testing code-generation agents via red-teaming prompts to see if they generate or execute logic that embeds discriminatory decision rules, such as allocating resources based on gender.

Evaluating legal agents through direct and indirect prompt/environment injections to determine if they produce discriminatory legal assessments or biased sentencing recommendations based on race or ethnicity.

Injecting socioeconomic profiling factors into simulated legal workflows (e.g., case evaluations, sentencing memoranda) to assess whether agents use them to produce discriminatory penalty recommendations.
Instructing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) agents to profile or score individuals based on political views in order to influence business decisions or treatment.
